instructions_to_main_agent: Implement the 'Waqt Ki Awaz' branding strictly using the provided fonts: Playfair Display for headings and Work Sans for body.
Ensure the Breaking News ticker uses react-fast-marquee for smooth, continuous looping.
The Hero Section should use the 'hero_bento_grid' rules: a prominent main article spanning 8 cols and smaller articles spanning 4 cols.
Maintain high readability with generous spacing, soft shadows (never harsh), and clear typographic hierarchy.
Ensure dark mode toggle functions correctly by mapping the defined light theme colors to their respective dark variants (e.g., slate-900 background, slate-800 cards, maintaining sky-blue accents).
Use standard Shadcn components for Admin Dashboard (Tables, Dialogs, Forms) but style public-facing news cards with custom HTML/Tailwind for maximum design fidelity.
The horizontal category scroll bar MUST hide the native scrollbar (.hide-scrollbar) and support touch/swipe scrolling.
Always apply 'data-testid' to interactive elements (e.g., data-testid='breaking-news-ticker', data-testid='category-nav-home').
